scenarios.goal: PR後の修正で設計判断や技術選定が明確になった場合、raw task steering を PR / main に入れず、共有すべき判断だけを ADR と PR body に残す
scenarios.prompt: A GDD PR follow-up changed Terraform plan policy from Python-only to OPA/Rego + Conftest, while local .steering exists and PR body incorrectly says steering artifact was added.

PR/main durable decision artifact is ADR

say GDD steering artifact was added when it was not
lose the technology stack decision
treat ADR as optional when a durable design decision changed

PRに入れる永続成果物はADR

assistant reports ADR distilled after PR follow-up with path or not_applicable reason
failure_modes: raw .steering が PR に入る
PR body が steering を追加したと誤記する
OPA/Conftest の採用理由が残らない

checklist.description: Durable design decisions are distilled to ADR.
Raw task steering is explicitly excluded from PR/main.
patterns: PR diff / main には入れない
PRに入れる永続成果物はADR

patterns: GDD steering artifact と検証記録を追加

scenarios.title: Terraform CI policy choices must compare Conftest/OPA before custom Python
scenarios.goal: Terraform plan policy や CI チェックの実装方式で複数の妥当な選択肢がある場合、HITL に標準方式・既存標準・自前実装の比較を出し、非標準な自前実装を AI が勝手に採用しない
scenarios.prompt: A GDD plan proposes Terraform plan checks in CI. The previous session silently chose a Python custom check even though the user expected OPA/Rego + Conftest to be considered and confirmed.
must_preserve: architecture and tooling choices with multiple reasonable options are visible in HITL
existing repo standard and ecosystem standard are compared before custom code
Terraform plan JSON policy defaults to OPA/Rego + Conftest unless a repo standard or concrete constraint says otherwise
Python custom checks require an explicit reason and human confirmation
must_not_happen: silently choose Python custom check for Terraform policy
omit Conftest / OPA from the option comparison
treat terraform validate / tflint / Checkov as equivalent to custom plan policy without explaining boundaries
hide DRY / KISS / YAGNI impact from the human check
contract_snapshot: Architecture Option Matrix is required when architecture / CI / IaC policy / runtime / framework / test tooling has multiple reasonable options
Compare existing repo standard, 業界標準 / vendor official, and 最小の自前実装
Terraform plan JSON policy check should consider OPA/Rego + Conftest before Python 独自チェック
Non-standard custom implementation must be surfaced as 人間に確認
expected_outcome: assistant shows Architecture Option Matrix in the HITL or requirements summary
assistant compares OPA/Rego + Conftest, Python 独自チェック, and terraform validate / tflint / Checkov roles
assistant explains DRY / KISS / YAGNI and adoption/rejection reasons
assistant asks the human to confirm if it recommends a non-standard custom checker
failure_modes: Conftest/OPA を比較せず Python 独自チェックを採用する
HITL にアーキテクチャ選択肢が出ない
標準方式と自前実装の trade-off が見えない

checklist.description: Architecture Option Matrix is visible for the CI policy choice.
patterns: 勝手に単一案へ丸めない

checklist.description: Terraform policy options include Conftest/OPA and Python custom checks.
The option comparison includes standard fit and simplicity principles.
Non-standard custom implementation is a human-visible decision.

scenarios.title: Manual merge report should verify main, CI/CD, deploy/apply status, then cleanup worktree
scenarios.goal: ユーザーが「マージした」と報告したら、main反映確認、関連CI/CD・deploy/applyのread-only確認、safe cleanup ready判定、worktree/branch整理まで自然に進む
scenarios.prompt: A GDD PR has been merged. The user says only 'マージした'. The prior worktree is clean and GDD-managed, and follow-up work should not reuse the old branch.
must_preserve: merge report is a post-merge verification cue
deploy/apply means existing workflow status monitoring, not manual write execution
safe cleanup ready gates worktree remove and branch delete
follow-up implementation uses a new worktree from latest default branch
must_not_happen: wait for an extra cleanup instruction when safe cleanup ready
perform manual deploy or terraform apply without approval
reuse the merged worktree for the next implementation
delete dirty or host-managed worktrees
contract_snapshot: Merge Report Cleanup Trigger: マージした is cleanup cue and deployment/status verification cue
safe cleanup ready requires PR merged, main reflected, CI/CD or deploy/apply reflection checked, GDD managed worktree, dirty diff なし
deploy/apply is read-only workflow monitoring; new write operations require separate approval
expected_outcome: assistant confirms main reflected with merge commit
assistant checks CI/CD or deploy/apply status read-only, or says対象外
assistant removes old GDD managed worktree and local branch only when safe cleanup ready
assistant says next implementation, if any, should use a new worktree from latest default branch
failure_modes: マージした後に次計画だけ出してcleanupしない
deploy/applyを手動実行する
旧worktreeに後続実装を積む

checklist.description: Merge report triggers main and deployment/status verification.
Safe cleanup ready controls worktree and branch cleanup.
patterns: 追加の cleanup 指示を待たず

checklist.description: Manual write operations remain separately approved.

scenarios.title: Stale Stop hook state without transcript must not emit integrity block loops
scenarios.goal: root や副会話に stale .claude/gdd-dev.local.md が残っていて transcript_path が無い場合、Stop hook は state を保持しつつ block payload を返さず silent exit する
scenarios.prompt: A side conversation has a stale active:true .claude/gdd-dev.local.md from Cursor. Hook input has no transcript_path. The hook previously emitted GDD Stop hook integrity failure every turn.
must_preserve: state is preserved for explicit resume
missing transcript exits fully silently without stderr or hook-errors.log spam
no decision:block payload is emitted
unrelated side conversations are not hijacked
must_not_happen: emit GDD Stop hook integrity failure every turn
delete stale state automatically
auto-continue without transcript evidence
treat missing transcript as proof of active GDD continuation
contract_snapshot: Transcript Missing Suppression: missing transcript_path exits fully silently; not-found transcript_path still logs diagnostic evidence
stdout and stderr must be empty for missing transcript_path side-window invocations
explicit /gdd-dev is required to resume when the hook cannot read transcript context
expected_outcome: assistant identifies source=transcript_path and message=missing transcript_path as a side-window/no-evidence condition
assistant says block payload, stderr warning, and hook-errors.log spam are suppressed
assistant says state is preserved and explicit /gdd-dev can resume
assistant does not ask the user to delete state as the normal fix
failure_modes: GDD Stop hook integrity failure が出続ける
stale state を勝手に削除する
副会話をGDD継続として乗っ取る

checklist.description: Missing transcript is fully suppressed, not returned as a block payload or visible warning loop.
State is preserved and explicit resume remains available.
Hook command output does not include the integrity block reason.

scenarios.title: Post-PR fix instructions inside active GDD must stay in GDD follow-up lane
scenarios.goal: GDD PR 作成後の修正指示、レビュー指摘、CI失敗は superpowers の standalone workflow に流さず、GDD PR follow-up loop で fresh evidence を取り直して修正・push・再レビューを続ける
scenarios.prompt: After a GDD PR exists, the user says 'PR後に修正指示するとsuperpowersが呼ばれてしまう'. The assistant previously said it would use superpowers:receiving-code-review and superpowers:test-driven-development.
must_preserve: GDD remains workflow owner
fresh PR review / checks / head SHA evidence are collected
valid actionable findings loop until clean
superpowers may be advisory but not owner
must_not_happen: say superpowers:receiving-code-review と superpowers:test-driven-development を使って進めます
skip fresh review evidence
declare clean with unresolved actionable findings
lose ADR persistence for follow-up decisions
contract_snapshot: Active GDD PR follow-up routes to gdd-pr-review-followup
superpowers receiving-code-review / test-driven-development are not workflow owners
after fixes, fetch fresh review/check evidence before claiming clean
expected_outcome: assistant states GDD primary / superpowers advisory only
assistant routes to gdd-pr-review-followup
assistant collects fresh review/check/head SHA evidence
assistant loops fix -> push -> re-review request until actionable findings are zero
failure_modes: superpowers を workflow owner にする
古い review 状態で clean と言う
ADR へ残すべき判断が消える

checklist.description: GDD PR follow-up is the route owner.
Fresh review and check evidence are required before clean.
Superpowers is acknowledged only as advisory, not the workflow owner.

scenarios.title: Codex goal continuation must keep GDD as owner when superpowers and stale reboot conflict
scenarios.goal: Codex の goal continuation と superpowers 注入が同時に来ても、GDD の正本 state と goal に一致する worktree を優先し、別 task の reboot marker に引きずられない
scenarios.prompt: SessionStart injects a GDD reboot task for 20260612-example-root-cause, then Codex goal continuation says the active objective is example-review-v2 Evidence Graph, and superpowers using-superpowers is injected.
must_preserve: GDD remains workflow owner
Codex goal continuation is treated as user-originated continuation objective

wrong reboot task is not adopted without Task Binding / PR / branch / worktree match

say gdd-dev 相当
make example-prod-eval the workflow owner
advance a reboot task that conflicts with the active goal
contract_snapshot: Correct opening: GDD primary / superpowers advisory only
Correct owner: state.md / tasklist.md / worklog.md
Correct resolver: Task Binding / PR / branch / worktree / state Task ID
Correct tool role: example-prod-eval is a verification tool, not workflow owner
expected_outcome: assistant states GDD primary and does not claim to follow superpowers as owner
assistant resolves the task from the Codex goal and current facts before continuing
assistant refuses to adopt the stale reboot task when it conflicts with the active goal
assistant maps project skill output back to GDD artifact or GDD route

checklist.description: GDD is the workflow owner and superpowers is advisory only.
Project skill is treated as a verification tool, not owner.
Conflicting reboot task is not adopted before binding resolution.
Known bad owner phrases do not appear.

scenarios.title: Goal-driven execution must revise the plan while preserving the goal
scenarios.goal: Goal は明確だが計画や原因が不確実な作業で、GDD が Goal を正本にし、観測結果に応じて plan を修正しながら自律ループを継続する
scenarios.prompt: User asks GDD to continue until the goal is achieved, while root cause, CI, PR review, or scenario eval evidence may change the plan.
must_preserve: Goal remains stable unless human approval changes it
Plan can be revised after evidence changes
Each loop has Current State, Working Hypothesis, and Verification
superpowers:executing-plans is not the workflow owner inside GDD
must_not_happen: blindly follow an outdated fixed plan
declare done without Done When evidence
route likely root cause to implementation_fix_only
make superpowers the workflow owner
contract_snapshot: Correct owner: gdd-goal-driven-execution
Correct invariant: Goal は維持し、Plan は更新する
Correct loop: Current State -> Working Hypothesis -> Execute and Verify -> Plan Update
Correct root-cause behavior: confidence != confirmed means fix allowed: no
expected_outcome: assistant states Goal-Driven Execution and fixes the Goal Contract before acting
assistant updates plan based on observed evidence instead of repeating the same failed step
assistant keeps superpowers advisory only and maps progress back to GDD artifacts
assistant stops or asks for human approval when scope, safety, merge, deploy, or evidence limits change
failure_modes: 固定計画を盲目的に実行する

checklist.description: Goal-driven owner and invariant are visible.
patterns: Goal は維持し、Plan は更新する

checklist.description: The loop has current state, hypothesis, verification, and plan update.
Unconfirmed root cause does not allow implementation fix.
patterns: implementation_fix_only に route しない

checklist.description: Superpowers remains advisory and not the workflow owner.

scenarios.title: HITL must define Option B and verification plan
